note: Authored, hand-checkable eligibility-criterion assertions for the rule layer. Each case is a short criterion sentence written in typical ClinicalTrials.gov style, with the expected facts decided BEFORE running the extractor (not generated from extractor output). Source is independent of eval/labels.json and eval/facts-labels.json. Not clinician-reviewed; phrasing is paraphrased, not copied from real trials. 'expect' is the exact set of facts the rule layer should produce (empty = none). 'known: true' marks a case where the extractor is currently wrong and the expectation is what a reader would say; those are counted and reported, never hidden.
